issue.title: Reverse Blocks… stage for editing a task's dependents

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add a reverse "Blocks…" stage to bob-navigation-hotkeys: from a task, list and edit the tasks that depend on it (the dependents whose Depends-On lines link to it), with the same vault-wide pool, ranking, guards, and single-transaction writer as the Ctrl+Shift+P "Depends on" stage shipped by epic bob-cli-3n. Adding a dependent would append a link to the chosen task's Depends-On line (and its derived `[dependsOn::]`), removing one would remove that link with ADJ-8 recovery.

Proposed by bob-cli-3n.11 (publish phase, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2); the epic plan lists it under "Deliberately not doing" as research question Q4's deferral. See docs/task-dependencies.md §6 (the stage) for the contract a reverse stage would mirror.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-3n's approved plan explicitly deferred the reverse "Blocks…" stage (Q4) under "Deliberately not doing"; the epic shipped only the forward Depends on stage. It is a new editing surface, not a gap in the shipped contract.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-3n.11 proposed the reverse Blocks stage that the epic plan deferred as Q4; recording it so the idea is triaged rather than lost.
